writingNotes.payerNote: New York has zero payer enrollments. NY is absent from lib/insurance-data.js insuranceByState, so getPayerMode('NY') resolves to self-pay-only and assertPayerTruth blocks any payer claim. writingNotes.lymeNote: NYS DOH's 2025 tick-borne disease report names the Capital District as the region with the highest incidence of Lyme disease, anaplasmosis and babesiosis for 2020 to 2024, and notes that New York moved to laboratory-only Lyme case reporting after the 2022 national case definition change, so part of the recent rise in counts is definitional. Do not quote a statewide case count on condition pages without that caveat.

voiceProfile.voiceNotes: Direct and practical, for a reader who is busy and skeptical of fine print. New York's physician advertising rules are strict, so every claim stays factual and checkable. Two audiences share one page: New Yorkers anywhere in the state, and visitors who are physically in New York during the visit. Say plainly that licensing follows location, not home address.

stateHero.openingParagraph: Adults who are physically in New York can book a same-day video visit with Parth Bhavsar, MD, a board-certified family medicine physician licensed in the state (license 345804). That includes New Yorkers anywhere in the state, from the five boroughs to Long Island, the Hudson Valley, the Capital Region, Rochester, Syracuse and Buffalo, and visitors here for work or travel: licensing follows where you are during the visit, not your home address. Every visit is with a physician, not a rotating nurse practitioner network. The fee is a flat $79, shown before you book and paid at booking. TeleDirectMD does not bill insurance in New York; HSA and FSA cards are accepted. Prescriptions, when appropriate, are sent electronically to the pharmacy you choose.

stateEligibility.intro: TeleDirectMD sees adults 18 and older who are physically located in New York State during the video visit. The state's telehealth law, Public Health Law Article 29-G, defines telehealth as the use of electronic information and communication technologies to deliver health care services, including assessment, diagnosis, consultation and treatment. What matters for eligibility is where you are when the visit happens. A visitor in a Manhattan hotel or a student on a semester in Ithaca can be seen. A resident on a trip to a state TeleDirectMD does not serve cannot be seen until they are back in New York or in another served state.
localTriggers: You must be physically in New York State at the time of the visit. Your home address, driver's license state and insurance do not change this.
Visitors count. New York City drew 65 million visitors in 2025 (NYC Tourism + Conventions); a visitor physically in New York during the visit is eligible like any adult resident.
Commuters should check where they will be during the visit: a patient in New Jersey or Connecticut at visit time is seen under that state's rules, not New York's.
Adults 18 and older only. TeleDirectMD does not see children in New York or anywhere else.

statePricing.context: Every visit is a flat $79 self-pay fee, shown before you book and paid at booking. There is no insurance billing, no copay tier, no facility fee and no follow-up bill for the visit. HSA and FSA cards are accepted. Medicine prescribed during the visit is paid at the pharmacy, as it would be after any visit. Residents who need insurance can compare plans, including the Essential Plan, through NY State of Health, the state's official marketplace, and uninsured New York City residents can ask about NYC Care, the city's program through NYC Health + Hospitals.
additionalNotes: $79 flat self-pay, the full visit fee.
HSA and FSA cards accepted at booking.
No insurance billing in New York.

stateTreatmentContext.pharmacyAndRx: New York requires prescriptions to be transmitted electronically from prescriber to pharmacy (Public Health Law Section 281; the state Department of Health has enforced the mandate for controlled and non-controlled prescriptions since March 27, 2016). When a prescription is appropriate, it goes straight to the pharmacy you choose: a CVS, Walgreens or Duane Reade in the city, a Wegmans or Kinney Drugs pharmacy upstate, a Walmart pharmacy, or an independent pharmacy near you. A pharmacy here can dispense only on a prescription from a person legally authorized to issue it (Education Law Section 6810), so a visitor's home-country prescription cannot be filled in New York; a New York-licensed physician who evaluates you can decide whether a new prescription is appropriate. TeleDirectMD does not prescribe controlled substances in any state.

stateEpidemiology.general: New York's seasons shape what brings adults to a visit. Flu activity usually builds through December; the state Department of Health formally declared influenza prevalent on December 2, 2025, December 18, 2024 and December 6, 2023, and TeleDirectMD's FluHub tracks the state's flu activity weekly. Tick-borne disease is concentrated outside New York City: the Department of Health's 2025 tick-borne disease report names the Capital District as the region with the highest incidence of Lyme disease, anaplasmosis and babesiosis for 2020 to 2024, with high counts on Long Island and in the Hudson Valley, and adult blacklegged ticks stay active into the fall. The city's density and visitor volume mean respiratory and sexually transmitted infections spread quickly, which is why both the state and the city publish their own clinical guidance on doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis. This context is for awareness only and is not a substitute for an individual evaluation.

stateCities.metroAndRural: TeleDirectMD sees adults located anywhere in New York State, about 20 million residents (U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 estimate) plus everyone visiting. That covers all five boroughs (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Staten Island), Long Island's Nassau and Suffolk counties, Westchester, Rockland and the rest of the Hudson Valley, the Capital Region around Albany, Schenectady and Troy, Central New York around Syracuse and Utica, the Finger Lakes and Rochester, Western New York from Buffalo to Niagara Falls, the Southern Tier around Binghamton, and the North Country and Adirondacks. Rural upstate patients and Manhattan patients pay the same flat $79 and get the same physician.

stateInsurance.selfPayDisclosure: TeleDirectMD is self-pay only in New York: no commercial insurance, no Medicaid and no Medicare billing. Every visit is a flat $79, paid at booking, with no facility fee or follow-up bill for the visit. HSA and FSA cards are accepted. If you have insurance, you can still choose a TeleDirectMD visit at $79 and ask your plan about out-of-network reimbursement; TeleDirectMD does not file claims and cannot promise reimbursement. If you need coverage, NY State of Health lists marketplace plans and the Essential Plan, and uninsured New York City residents can ask NYC Health + Hospitals about NYC Care.

stateFaqs.question: Can I see a doctor online in New York without insurance?
stateFaqs.answer: Yes. TeleDirectMD offers same-day video visits for adults physically located in New York for a flat $79, paid at booking, with no insurance needed. Every visit is with Parth Bhavsar, MD, a board-certified family medicine physician licensed in New York (license 345804). HSA and FSA cards are accepted. The visit is not for emergencies: for chest pain, trouble breathing or signs of a stroke, call 911.

stateFaqs.question: I'm visiting New York. Can I use TeleDirectMD?
stateFaqs.answer: Yes, if you are physically in New York during the visit. Licensing follows where the patient is, not where they live, so a visitor in a Manhattan hotel can be seen like any resident. Bring a photo ID and a card for the $79 fee. If a prescription is appropriate, it is sent electronically to a pharmacy near where you are staying; a prescription from your home country cannot be filled at a New York pharmacy.

stateFaqs.question: Is Dr. Bhavsar licensed in New York, and how can I check?
stateFaqs.answer: Yes. Parth Bhavsar, MD holds New York medical license 345804. Physician licenses in New York are issued and registered by the State Education Department's Office of the Professions, and anyone can look a license up through its online verification search. His National Provider Identifier is 1104323203.

stateFaqs.question: Does TeleDirectMD take insurance in New York?
stateFaqs.answer: No. TeleDirectMD is self-pay only in New York: a flat $79 per visit, with no insurance, Medicaid or Medicare billing. If you need coverage, NY State of Health, the state's official marketplace, lists plans including the Essential Plan, and uninsured New York City residents can ask NYC Health + Hospitals about NYC Care.

stateFaqs.question: Which New York pharmacies can receive my prescription?
stateFaqs.answer: Any New York pharmacy that accepts electronic prescriptions, which state law requires (Public Health Law Section 281). That includes CVS, Walgreens and Duane Reade in New York City, Wegmans and Kinney Drugs upstate, Walmart pharmacies and independent pharmacies. You choose the pharmacy when you book.

stateFaqs.question: What can't a video visit handle in New York?
stateFaqs.answer: Emergencies (call 911 for chest pain, trouble breathing, stroke signs, heavy bleeding or sudden confusion), controlled substances, which TeleDirectMD does not prescribe, care for anyone under 18, and problems that need a hands-on exam, a same-day test or imaging. If a video visit is not the right fit, Dr. Bhavsar will say so and point you to in-person care.

stateFaqs.question: How much does it cost to see a doctor without insurance in New York City?
stateFaqs.answer: It depends on where you go, so ask for the self-pay price before any visit. A TeleDirectMD video visit is a flat $79, paid at booking, and medication costs at the pharmacy are separate. New York City residents who cannot get health insurance can apply for NYC Care through NYC Health + Hospitals: there are no membership fees, monthly fees or premiums, the cost of care is based on family size and income and starts at $0, and immigration status does not matter. NYC Health + Hospitals sees patients regardless of insurance status or ability to pay. Urgent care centers and emergency departments set their own self-pay prices. For chest pain, trouble breathing or stroke signs, call 911.

uti-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: For women in New York with typical, uncomplicated bladder infection symptoms (burning, frequency, urgency), a video visit is often enough to decide on treatment. The New York State Department of Health's adult outpatient treatment recommendations note that cloudy or foul-smelling urine alone does not diagnose a UTI, and that treating bacteria found in urine without symptoms is not recommended for healthy adults. TeleDirectMD's UTI care is limited to non-pregnant adult women; men with urinary symptoms, and anyone with fever, flank pain, vomiting or pregnancy, should be seen in person. When an antibiotic is appropriate, it is sent electronically to the pharmacy you choose. Flat $79 for adults physically in New York.

sore-throat-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Sore throats peak in New York in late fall and winter; searches for strep throat across the state run about 40,000 a month in November and December. Most adult sore throats are viral, and the 2025 IDSA strep guideline estimates group A strep at 5 to 15 percent of adult cases, so the key question is whether you need a strep test. A video visit can sort out who needs testing and who does not, and can point you to a nearby pharmacy or urgent care for a swab when one is needed. Flat $79 for adults physically in New York.

influenza-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Flu activity in New York usually builds through December; the state Department of Health declared influenza prevalent on December 2, 2025, December 18, 2024 and December 6, 2023. Antiviral treatment works best when started early, ideally within 48 hours of symptoms, and matters most for adults at higher risk. A same-day video visit for adults physically in New York can decide whether an antiviral is appropriate and send it to your pharmacy. For what is circulating now, the Department of Health's New York State Flu Tracker posts lab-confirmed flu cases and hospitalizations by county every Friday from October through May, and TeleDirectMD's FluHub charts the state's weekly activity against past seasons. Flat $79.

covid-19-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: For adults in New York with a positive COVID-19 test and mild to moderate symptoms, timing matters: oral antivirals are started within the first days of symptoms, and some interact with common medicines, so a medication review is part of the visit. A video visit for adults physically in New York can review your test, symptoms and medication list, and when treatment is appropriate send a prescription electronically to a New York pharmacy. Trouble breathing or chest pain needs 911, not a video visit. Flat $79.

sinus-infection-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Most sinus infections in New York adults start as colds and clear without antibiotics. A video visit helps separate those from the smaller group that meets guideline criteria for a bacterial sinus infection: symptoms lasting 10 days or more without improvement, or getting worse again after starting to improve. For adults physically in New York, Dr. Bhavsar can review your timeline, suggest what helps at home, and send a prescription to a New York pharmacy when one is appropriate. Flat $79.

tick-bite-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Tick bites are a real concern across much of New York outside the city. The New York State Department of Health's 2025 tick-borne disease report names the Capital District as the region with the highest incidence of Lyme disease, anaplasmosis and babesiosis for 2020 to 2024, with high counts on Long Island and in the Hudson Valley, and adult blacklegged ticks stay active into the fall. A video visit for adults in New York can go over how long the tick was attached and where you were, decide whether a single dose of preventive antibiotic is appropriate, and explain what rash or fever to watch for. Flat $79.

chlamydia-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: For adults in New York with a positive chlamydia test, a video visit can confirm the result, prescribe treatment when appropriate and cover retesting and partner notification. Public Health Law Section 2312 allows expedited partner therapy for chlamydia and for other sexually transmitted infections the CDC recommends it for, which lets a clinician provide treatment for a patient's sex partner without a separate exam; whether it fits your situation is decided during the visit. Prescriptions go electronically to the pharmacy you choose. Flat $79, discreet, for adults physically in New York.

doxypep-sti-prevention-online.stateConditionParagraph: Doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis (doxy-PEP) is a single dose of doxycycline taken within 72 hours after condomless sex to lower the chance of syphilis, gonorrhea and chlamydia. New York was early on it: the New York State Department of Health AIDS Institute published doxy-PEP clinical guidance on September 25, 2023, and the New York City Health Department issued its own provider guidance on November 9, 2023. A video visit for adults physically in the state reviews whether you meet the criteria, the side effects and the testing schedule that goes with it. Flat $79.

pink-eye-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Pink eye spreads easily in shared New York spaces such as offices, subway cars and dorms, and most cases are viral or allergic rather than bacterial. A video visit lets Dr. Bhavsar look at the eye on camera, ask about discharge, contact lenses and vision changes, and decide whether a prescription eye drop is appropriate. Eye pain, light sensitivity, vision loss or contact lens wear with a red eye need same-day in-person care. Flat $79 for adults physically in New York.

yeast-infection-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Yeast infection is the most-searched condition in TeleDirectMD's catalog in New York, about 44,000 searches a month across related terms. For adult women in New York with typical symptoms and no red flags, a video visit can confirm whether the picture fits a yeast infection or something that looks similar, such as bacterial vaginosis or trichomoniasis, and send treatment to a New York pharmacy when appropriate. Recurrent infections or pregnancy change the plan and are discussed during the visit. Flat $79.

tinea-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Most ringworm, athlete's foot and jock itch still clears with standard antifungal treatment, but New York City is where the first U.S. cases of Trichophyton indotineae were found, including a patient with no recent travel, which points to local spread (CDC MMWR, May 2023). That strain is frequently resistant to terbinafine. In 2024 the CDC also reported a sexually transmitted ringworm strain, T. mentagrophytes genotype VII, in four New York City men. If a rash keeps spreading or comes back after a full course of treatment, it needs a fungal culture rather than another round of the same cream. Flat $79 for adults physically in New York.

hypertension-refills-online.stateConditionParagraph: About 5 million adults in New York State, 32.1 percent, have been told they have high blood pressure, and 77 percent of them take medicine for it. Among adults without health coverage, only 40.7 percent do (NYS Department of Health, BRFSS Brief 2025-01, 2023 data). A gap in refills is one of the ways blood pressure control slips. A video visit for adults physically in New York can review your home readings, renew a stable regimen and send it electronically to the pharmacy you choose, at a flat $79 with no insurance needed. New York City also requires chain restaurants to flag menu items with 2,300 mg of sodium or more, the first U.S. city to do so.

cat-bite-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Cat bites carry a higher infection risk than most people expect, and in New York they also raise a rabies question. The state Department of Health reports that among domestic animals, cats are the ones most often diagnosed with rabies in New York, rabid animals have been found in every county, and the Wadsworth Center confirmed rabies in 313 animals in 2025. The Department advises reporting every animal bite to your county health department, which arranges a 10-day observation of a healthy cat and helps decide whether rabies treatment is needed; in New York City, report through 311. A video visit for adults physically in New York covers wound care, antibiotics when appropriate and that rabies decision. Flat $79.

trichomoniasis-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Since January 1, 2020, New York's expedited partner therapy law, Public Health Law Section 2312, has covered sexually transmitted infections for which the CDC recommends expedited treatment, and the state Department of Health lists trichomoniasis alongside chlamydia and gonorrhea. Before that change, New York allowed it for chlamydia only. It lets a clinician provide treatment for a patient's sex partner without a separate exam; whether it fits your situation is decided during the visit. A video visit for adults physically in New York can prescribe treatment when appropriate, send it electronically to the pharmacy you choose and plan retesting. Flat $79, discreet.

bv-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Bacterial vaginosis is the most common cause of vaginal discharge worldwide, and it often comes back: the New York State Department of Health AIDS Institute notes that more than half of people have a recurrence within 6 months. Its 2026 guidance supports treating ongoing male partners, but BV is not eligible for expedited partner therapy in New York, so a partner needs a separate visit. In New York City, all Health Department Sexual Health Clinics now offer BV partner treatment, mostly walk-in, regardless of immigration status. A video visit for adult women physically in New York can evaluate symptoms and prescribe treatment when appropriate. Flat $79, discreet.

genital-herpes-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Genital herpes is far more common than most people realize. In a New York City blood-test survey, nearly 28 percent of adults had HSV-2, and 88.4 percent of them did not know it (NYC Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, 2004 data, published in Sexually Transmitted Diseases, 2008). That is why a first outbreak often comes as a surprise. A video visit for adults physically in New York can assess a first or recurrent outbreak, prescribe antiviral treatment or suppressive therapy when appropriate and send it electronically to the pharmacy you choose. Flat $79, discreet.

acid-reflux-refills-online.stateConditionParagraph: A refill visit for acid reflux is also a check for warning signs. The American College of Gastroenterology recommends endoscopy for reflux with trouble swallowing, weight loss, bleeding, vomiting or anemia, and advises taking a proton pump inhibitor at the lowest dose that controls symptoms. Esophageal cancer is uncommon, but the New York State Department of Health counts about 1,080 new cases a year statewide (2016 to 2020 average). For adults physically in New York whose symptoms are stable, a video visit can review your current medicine, screen for those signs and renew it when appropriate. Flat $79.

cold-sore-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Cold sores are caused by herpes simplex virus, and type 1, the usual cause of oral herpes, is very common in New York. In the New York City Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, 71.1 percent of adults tested had HSV-1 antibodies. For many people a cold sore clears on its own in 7 to 14 days, and treatment started early can ease discomfort and speed healing, per the American Academy of Dermatology. A sore near the eye, or an eye that becomes painful or light sensitive, needs an eye doctor right away. A video visit for adults physically in New York can decide whether an antiviral is appropriate. Flat $79.

dandruff-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Scalp seborrheic dermatitis often flares when the weather turns cold and dry, according to the American Academy of Dermatology, which lists zinc pyrithione, salicylic acid, sulfur, selenium sulfide, ketoconazole and coal tar as dandruff shampoo ingredients to look for. When over-the-counter products are not enough, a video visit for adults physically in New York can look at the scalp on camera and decide whether a prescription shampoo or other treatment is appropriate. In New York, Education Law Section 6810 lets a pharmacist fill a prescription with a generic product unless the prescriber marks it dispense as written. Dandruff that persists or is severe deserves a dermatologist's evaluation. Flat $79.

ear-pain-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: A video visit cannot look at the eardrum; that takes an otoscope, in person. A visit can sort out whether your symptoms fit swimmer's ear, an ear canal infection that, per the American Academy of Otolaryngology, occurs when water stays trapped in the canal, and treat it with ear drops when appropriate. In New York City, a combined sewer overflow advisory is issued when heavy rain or snow spills untreated sewage into the waters around New York Harbor, water that may carry illness-causing bacteria. Severe pain with fever and swelling behind the ear, facial weakness or sudden hearing loss needs in-person care. Flat $79 for adults physically in New York.

eczema-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: In New York City, heat season runs from October 1 to May 31: landlords must keep apartments at 68 degrees or warmer by day when it is below 55 outside, and 62 or warmer overnight. That means months of cold air outside and heated rooms inside. The American Academy of Dermatology notes that cold can dry the skin and that sweating from overheating can also trigger flares, and advises moisturizing after bathing. A video visit for adults physically in New York can review a flare on camera and adjust treatment when appropriate. Fever, pus, golden crusts or a rash that spreads rapidly needs in-person care. Flat $79.

erectile-dysfunction-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Erectile dysfunction can be a symptom of another health problem. The NIH lists diabetes and heart and blood vessel diseases, such as high blood pressure, among the most common causes, and an estimated 1.8 million adult New Yorkers, 11.3 percent, have diagnosed diabetes (state Department of Health, 2022 data). A video visit for adult men physically in New York starts with your health history and medicines. The FDA label for sildenafil says it must not be used with nitrates, and chest pain, dizziness or nausea during sex calls for medical help right away. When treatment is appropriate, it is sent electronically to the pharmacy you choose. Flat $79, discreet.

hair-loss-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Treating male pattern hair loss is long term: the FDA label for finasteride notes that stopping it reverses the effect within 12 months. Under New York Education Law Section 6826, every pharmacy must give you its retail price list for the 150 most frequently prescribed drugs on request, updated at least weekly. A video visit for adults physically in New York can assess the pattern and discuss options when appropriate. Finasteride is approved for men only, and a woman who is or may be pregnant should not handle crushed or broken tablets. Patchy bald spots, hair falling out in clumps, or a burning, tender scalp need in-person care. Flat $79.

psoriasis-refills-online.stateConditionParagraph: If your topical psoriasis prescription is out of refills, note that under Education Law Section 6810, a pharmacy cannot refill a prescription more times than the prescriber authorized, and a new prescription must be sent electronically. A video visit for adults physically in New York with stable, previously diagnosed plaque psoriasis can review your skin and regimen and renew it when appropriate. New joint symptoms call for a fuller evaluation: the American Academy of Dermatology notes that psoriatic arthritis often starts with a few puffy joints, a swollen finger or toe, or morning stiffness, most often 5 to 12 years after psoriasis begins. Flat $79.

scabies-treatment-online.stateConditionParagraph: Scabies spreads through skin-to-skin contact, including sex, and through shared clothing, towels and bedding, according to the New York City Health Department. It advises treating household members even without symptoms, and examining and treating sex and intimate partners from the past six weeks. A state Department of Health memo adds that control depends on treating exposed people at the same time. Clothing, bedding and towels should be machine washed and dried hot. A video visit for adults physically in New York can review the rash and plan treatment when appropriate. TeleDirectMD treats adults only, so children in the household need their own clinician. Thick, crusted skin needs in-person care. Flat $79.

blocks.statute: New York Public Health Law Article 29-G, Section 2999-cc (Telehealth Delivery of Services)
blocks.content: New York Public Health Law Section 2999-cc defines telehealth as the use of electronic information and communication technologies by telehealth providers to deliver health care services, including assessment, diagnosis, consultation, treatment, education, care management and self-management of a patient. TeleDirectMD delivers care to patients located in New York by real-time video, through a physician licensed in New York, under the same standard of care that applies in person.

blocks.statute: New York Public Health Law Section 281 (Electronic Prescribing)
blocks.content: New York requires prescriptions to be transmitted electronically from prescriber to pharmacy under Public Health Law Section 281, a requirement the New York State Department of Health has enforced since March 27, 2016. TeleDirectMD sends every New York prescription electronically to the pharmacy the patient chooses. TeleDirectMD does not prescribe controlled substances.
